::: {#sol-substitute-once}

Replacing $b_{n-1}$ gives $b_n$ in terms of $b_{n-2}$:

$$
\ba
b_n
&= 2 \paren{2 b_{n-2} + 2^{n-1}} + 2^n
\\&= 4 b_{n-2} + 2^n + 2^n
\\&= 4 b_{n-2} + 2 \cdot 2^n.
\ea
$$

Replacing $b_{n-2}$ then gives $b_n$ in terms of $b_{n-3}$:

$$
\ba
b_n
&= 4 \paren{2 b_{n-3} + 2^{n-2}} + 2 \cdot 2^n
\\&= 8 b_{n-3} + 2^n + 2 \cdot 2^n
\\&= 8 b_{n-3} + 3 \cdot 2^n.
\ea
$$

:::
